name: Reduced OD
source: NAS620 "WASHER, FLAT, REDUCED OUTSIDE DIAMETER", Table I, Rev 8 (2013-12-20), size code 416. innerDiameter = dia A MIN (+.010/-.000), outerDiameter = dia D MAX (+.015/-.005), thickness = T. Part number: NAS620-416 is the bare/plain steel, cadmium-plated form seeded here; a material letter inserts before the size code with no hyphen for a non-steel washer (A aluminum, B brass, C corrosion-resistant steel, N wear/galling-resistant CRES) -- e.g. NAS620C10 -- material is chosen separately in the GUI's washer-material dropdown, not carried in this key. NAS620 covers #0 through 1/4 only; nothing larger exists in this standard.
